subject: mudskipper
title: This Fish Spends Most of Its Time on Land and Breathes Through Its Skin

scenes.text: This fish walks out of the water and stays there.
Mudskippers live on tropical mudflats, and some species spend most of their time out of water.
They crawl on their front fins and flick their tails to jump across the mud.
In one species, up to three quarters of the oxygen it takes in on land comes through its skin.
Males even carry mouthfuls of air down into flooded burrows, so their eggs can breathe.
A fish that drowns its eggs in air, on purpose.

description:
Mudskippers are fish that live on tropical mudflats and can spend most of their time out of water, walking on their fins and jumping with their tails.
In one species the skin supplies about 76 percent of oxygen uptake in air; Japanese mudskipper males carry mouthfuls of air into burrow chambers where their eggs develop.
Would you call it a fish or something else?
thumbnail_text: A FISH THAT LIVES ON LAND
first_comment: A fish that breathes through its skin and carries air to its eggs. What's the weirdest fish you know?
